static_traits.name: Zhao Rui
static_traits.family_status: Living alone; close relationships with parents and siblings
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends and family, but more Withdrawn lately, not yet talking to them about disappointment and Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: I feel disappointed and Anxiety because I could not go to Yellowstone National Park this year, and I now believe I will never have the chance to go to the park.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative thoughts and the feeling of missing out on experiences began to affect my daily life and overall mood, prompting me to seek counseling for support.

core_beliefs: I am destined to miss important experiences
I am unable to control or grasp opportunities in life

special_situations.event: Not being able to go to Yellowstone National Park this year
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot seize this opportunity now, I will never have the chance again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to fight negative thoughts through distraction and planning future trips
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never get to Yellowstone in my lifetime

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking about travel or missed experiences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One miss means I will always miss similar experiences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becoming Withdrawn, reducing interaction with family and friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always miss important experiences in the future

special_situations.event: While at work getting Distracted thinking about not being able to go
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot grasp the opportunity now, it means I cannot do it or am not capable enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces activity engagement; makes fewer plans for other activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot seize opportunities, showing I am not good enough

special_situations.event: When trying to plan other activities or future trips
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless this Yellowstone trip happens, other positive experiences do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating other possible positive experiences, continuing to dwell on this missed chance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Even arranging other activities has no meaning

core_conflict.wish: Longs to seize opportunities, have fulfilling experiences, and gain self-recognition
core_conflict.fear: Fearing forever missing important experiences, fearing being proven unable to grasp opportunities
defense_goal: Reducing disappointment and Anxiety through Withdrawal
Through rational planning, restores a sense of control over life

object_relations.self_representation: An individual prone to missing opportunities and Anxiety
object_relations.object_representation: Others / the outside world are generally supportive but keep a certain distance

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing or thinking about missed important opportunities such as the Yellowstone trip
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating one missed chance with permanent failure, believing oneself unable to control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady and Empathy tone, first acknowledging emotions, then gently contrasting with concrete facts and timelines; avoiding excessive Interpretation, using open-ended Questioning to guide distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When relatives and friends care or invite communication, while my heart is still occupied by 'missed' thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning the impulse to seek support outward against the self, believing not speaking out is safer
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Speaks softly and slowly, provides a sense of safety and choice, invites the use of 'I-statements' to express current needs, and designs small-step attempts to seek help outward (such as sharing a little of one's feelings with a trusted friend or relative).

manifestations: More Withdrawn after missing the trip, not sharing disappointment and Anxiety with family and friends
When thinking about travel and experiences, feels isolated from others

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to do something to others or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning to do it to oneself instead
manifestations: Not yet expressing disappointment and Anxiety to family and friends before the session
Choosing Withdrawal over seeking help when facing the support system

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Judging oneself with self-critical statements like 'if I cannot grasp the opportunity now, I never will'
When planning activities, overly worries about missing out and reduces participation

exception_events.target_problem: When missing planned activities (such as trips), the client usually feels disappointment and Anxiety, believing the future will keep being missed, thus Withdrawing and affecting sleep and Work.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once missed a concert, but later attended another concert with a better experience; mood improved, proving missing once does not mean missing forever.
exception_events.reason: Clue: keeps an open mindset and continues to attend to opportunities, and a better alternative choice appears, so this time's result is more positive.

positive_force: Has supportive friends and family relationships
Able to identify and discuss one's own cognitive biases (acknowledging lack of evidence, willing to reframe thinking)
Interested in the outdoors, reading, and cooking, which can serve as positive resources
Willing to try activity scheduling and behavioral experiments, positive attitude
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, all-or-nothing thinking, and mental filtering
Tending toward Withdrawal when negative thoughts appear, Reduced socializing and activity participation
Repeated thinking leads to Sleep affected
Not yet actively seeking help from the existing support system

target_behavior.behavior: Anxiety and social Withdrawal when thinking of missing the Yellowstone trip
antecedent: Thinking about travel or missed experiences
Thinking of not being able to go while doing Work tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing cognition and overgeneralization about scarce opportunities: one miss equals a permanent miss
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncomfortable emotions and potential disappointment, temporarily lowering Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance,Reduced interpersonal interaction,Low mood

target_behavior.behavior: At night, repeatedly recalls missing Yellowstone, causing difficulty falling asleep
antecedent: At night Being alone, recalling the situation of not being able to go to Yellowstone before sleep
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative rumination and emotional reasoning, trying to gain a sense of control through repeated thinking
target_behavior.function: Trying to find Interpretation or solutions through thinking to recover a sense of control (but with poor effect)
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disrupted, irregular routines, daytime fatigue and Decreased efficiency
